title: 霓虹賽博朋克人像 (Neon Cyberpunk Portrait)
full_prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic portrait of a cyberpunk female character, neon facial implants, glowing circuitry, rainy Tokyo street background, volumetric fog, shot on 85mm lens, f/1.8, extreme detail on skin pores and raindrops, magenta and teal color palette, 8k resolution, unreal engine 5 render. | 超寫實電影感賽博朋克女性人像，面部霓虹植入物，發光電路，雨後東京街道背景，體積霧，85mm 鏡頭拍攝，f/1.8 光圈，極致的皮膚毛孔與雨滴細節，品紅與青色調，8k 分辨率，Unreal Engine 5 渲染。

title: 進擊的巨人 艾連 (Attack on Titan - Eren)
